name: vaccination-certificate
title: Vaccination certificate
for_each: select p.id, p.name from patients p where p.status = 'active' and exists (select 1 from vaccinations v where v.patient_id = p.id)

sections.title: Patient
sections.sql: select p.name, p.species, p.breed, p.sex, p.dob, coalesce(p.microchip, 'not on record') as microchip, c.name as owner, c.address, c.suburb from patients p join clients c on c.id = p.client_id where p.id = $1

sections.title: Vaccinations on record
sections.note: Recorded under the veterinarian who gave or directed each vaccination.
sections.sql: select v.vaccine, v.given_on, v.due_on as next_due, s.name as veterinarian, s.registration_number from vaccinations v join staff s on s.id = v.staff_id where v.patient_id = $1 order by v.given_on desc

name: client-statement
title: Statement of account
for_each: select c.id, c.name from clients c where exists (select 1 from invoices i where i.client_id = c.id and i.status = 'issued')

sections.title: Invoices outstanding
sections.sql: select i.ref, i.patient, i.issued_on, i.due_on, round(i.total_cents / 100.0, 2) as total_nzd, i.state from v_invoices i where i.client_id = $1 and i.status = 'issued' order by i.issued_on

sections.title: Recent payments
sections.sql: select i.ref, i.patient, i.paid_on, round(i.total_cents / 100.0, 2) as total_nzd from v_invoices i where i.client_id = $1 and i.status = 'paid' order by i.paid_on desc limit 6

name: clinical-history
title: Clinical history
for_each: select p.id, p.name from patients p where exists (select 1 from consults cn where cn.patient_id = p.id)

sections.title: Patient
sections.sql: select p.name, p.species, p.breed, p.sex, p.dob, coalesce(p.microchip, 'not on record') as microchip, p.status, c.name as owner from patients p join clients c on c.id = p.client_id where p.id = $1

sections.title: Consults
sections.note: For referrals and insurance claims. The full record, oldest first.
sections.sql: select cn.on_date, cn.type, cn.reason, cn.weight_kg, cn.notes, cn.vet from v_consults cn where cn.patient_id = $1 and cn.status = 'completed' order by cn.on_date

sections.title: Weights
sections.sql: select cn.on_date, cn.weight_kg from consults cn where cn.patient_id = $1 and cn.weight_kg is not null order by cn.on_date

name: drug-register
title: Controlled drug register
for_each: select i.id, i.code || ' ' || i.name as name from items i where i.controlled

sections.title: Register
sections.note: Every receipt, dispensing and witnessed disposal, with the running balance (Misuse of Drugs Regulations 1977).
sections.sql: select r.entry_on, r.movement, r.qty, r.balance_after, p.name as patient, cn.ref as consult, s.name as staff, r.witness, r.note from drug_register r left join patients p on p.id = r.patient_id left join consults cn on cn.id = r.consult_id join staff s on s.id = r.staff_id where r.item_id = $1 order by r.entry_on, r.created_at

sections.title: Reconciliation
sections.sql: select b.register_qty, b.shelf_qty, b.discrepancy, b.last_entry_on from v_register_balances b where b.item_id = $1
